"How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?":

If you're buying with fiat (credit card, Apple Pay, etc.) and new to crypto, don't worry — the process is designed to be simple. When you mint the book for $15 via Transak, a non-custodial wallet is automatically created for you behind the scenes (no seed phrase needed). This wallet holds your NFT and receives any commissions or prizes.

Here's how it works step by step:
During the Purchase:
Transak handles the fiat-to-crypto conversion and mints the NFT directly to a new wallet address for you.
You don't need to set up anything manually — it's seamless and non-custodial (you own the keys, but no complicated seed phrase to manage right away).
You'll get an email confirmation with your mint number (your referral code), NFT details, and a link to your dashboard on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz>.

Earning Commissions ($5 per Referral):
Share your referral code (e.g., "use 8421"). When someone mints with it, $5 is automatically sent to your wallet address.
To collect: Log into your dashboard on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz> (using the email link or SIWE with the wallet Transak created). Your commissions appear there instantly — no action needed. If needed, we'll guide you on exporting to a bank account or exchange (e.g., via Coinbase).

Earning and Winning Prizes (Tickets for $500/$10,000 Draws):
Each referral gives you tickets for the current prize draws. These are tied to your NFT/wallet automatically.
Draws happen on-chain (every ~100 sales for $500, ~10,000 for $10,000) via fair randomness.
Winners are announced on the Winners page and emailed to you.

To collect a prize: If you win, the amount ($500 or $10,000) is sent straight to your wallet.
Check your dashboard/email for notifications

Add FAQs:
How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?
If you're buying with fiat (credit card, Apple Pay, etc.) and new to crypto, don't worry — the process is designed to be simple. When you mint the book for $15 via Transak, a non-custodial wallet is automatically created for you behind the scenes (no seed phrase needed at first). This wallet holds your NFT and receives any commissions or prizes. Here's how it works step by step:

During the Purchase:
Transak handles the fiat-to-crypto conversion and mints the NFT directly to a new wallet address for you. You don't need to set up anything manually — it's seamless and non-custodial (you own the keys, but no complicated seed phrase to manage right away).
You'll get an email confirmation with your mint number (your referral code), NFT details, and a link to your dashboard on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz>.

Earning Commissions ($5 per Referral):
Share your referral code (e.g., "use 8421"). When someone mints with it, $5 is automatically sent to your wallet address.
To collect: Log into your dashboard on <http://projectrebuild.xyz|projectrebuild.xyz> (using the email link or SIWE with the wallet Transak created). Your commissions appear there instantly — no action needed.

Earning and Winning Prizes:

How Do I Collect My Commissions and Prizes? (For Beginners)
If you're new to this, don't worry — everything is automatic and easy to track. Here's how it works step by step:

Earning Commissions ($5 per Referral):
When someone mints the book using your referral code (your mint number, found in your dashboard or email confirmation), $5 is sent straight to your wallet instantly. No action needed from you — the smart contract handles it.

Earning Prize Tickets:
Every successful referral also gives you 1 ticket for the $500 prize, every 100 sales. These are automatically added to your NFT (visible in your dashboard).
No need to do anything — tickets are on-chain and tied to your mint number.

Winning and Collecting Prizes:
Prizes are drawn automatically using Chainlink VRF (a fair random system) when pools hit the trigger (every 100 sales). Winners are announced on the Winners page and via email (if you provided one).
If you win, $500 is sent to your wallet instantly. Check your dashboard for notifications — we'll also email you.
Tickets expire after the draw they're for, but new referrals get you tickets for the next blocks..
